1. Revision history¶

1.1. Version 1.0¶

  • Initial release.

1.2. Version 1.0.1¶

  • Use lcf_utils 1.0.1 to fix crash when parsing RJSON on systems with a .NET framework < 4.7.1

1.3. Version 1.0.2¶

  • Bug fix: Do not crash if path contains non-ascii characters.

1.4. Version 2.0¶

  • Replaced dump_config with store_config, which makes use of Prover iLock’s persistent storage mechanism instead of storing the configuration as files in the file system.

  • Replaced the read_alias_configuration method with use_alias_configuration. The latter method takes a variable_alias.lmc.AliasConfig object as a parameter instead of reading files.

1.5. Version 2.1¶

  • Updated dependency on variable_alias to 1.5.1 for Python 3 compatibility

  • Added support for project specific integration overrides for test and visualization programs

1.6. Version 2.2¶

  • Added support for the LCF2INTG-XXX-2.0 formats (via lcf_utils 2.0 and variable_alias 1.6).

1.7. Version 2.3¶

  • Variables that do _not_ come from instances, e.g. variables created by scripts, are now ignored (left unchanged)

1.8. Version 2.4¶

  • Updated lcf_utils version.
